storylines: CASEY: Next game, full roster hopefully, and I think this group comes out hungry. You don't blow a two-goal lead in overtime and just forget about it. That one stings, and that's fuel. GORD: What it needed was better discipline in the third. And — I don't know — maybe someone who plays the full sixty instead of getting himself thrown out. But sure. Fuel. Whatever you need to sleep at night. CASEY: Thanks for listening to Ice and Easy, the Village People Hockey Podcast. We'll see you next week. GORD: Keep your stick on the ice. And your temper off it, apparently.
